Test: records at sea

Source: R/test-docs.R
test_sea.Rd

Flags records outside the Natural Earth land polygons, by a planar point-in-polygon test in longitude and latitude through a grid index that resolves boundary cells exactly. The land layer is chosen with land_scale: 110 (default), 50, or 10. The 1:10m layer is downloaded once by download_reference().

Fields

lon, lat.

CoordinateCleaner

Equivalent to cc_sea() with its default scale = 110 (clean_coordinates() uses seas_scale = 50, which is land_scale = 50 here); identical flags on the same layer. CoordinateCleaner downloads the layer through rnaturalearth at run time; here it is bundled and pinned.

Custom gazetteer

gazetteers = list(sea = polygons), an sf or sfc object of land polygons; see flag_occurrences().

See also

flag_occurrences(), flag_tests(), reference_info()

Other tests: test_age_equal, test_basis, test_capital, test_centroid, test_country_mismatch, test_duplicate, test_equal, test_establishment, test_gbif_headquarters, test_gbif_issue, test_institution, test_invalid, test_urban, test_zero

Examples

x <- data.frame(decimalLongitude = c(12.58, 16.37, -30), decimalLatitude = c(55.67, 48.21, 40))
flag_occurrences(x, tests = "sea")$flag_sea
flag_occurrences(x, tests = "sea", land_scale = 50)$flag_sea
